mus_faces.png:
The reference image is the character sheet of this game's hero cat. Using EXACTLY the same art style and cuteness (huge glossy round eyes with big white highlights, tiny nose, small mouth, pink blush marks, thick black outlines, flat colours), draw SIX different head-and-shoulders designs of the same new character on one canvas, arranged in a 3 by 2 grid with a small numeral 1 to 6 drawn under each: Mus, a small turtle disciple with a RED headband with two trailing tails and a domed shell peeking behind the shoulders.
1: perfectly round smooth head like the cat (no shell texture on the head), enormous round eyes, wide happy smile.
2: same round head, eyes half-lidded and sleepy but still huge and glossy, gentle smile.
3: chubby cheeks, a tiny fang showing, cheerful grin, slightly lighter yellow-green skin.
4: rounder shorter snout like a baby turtle, big eyes, small open mouth going 'oh'.
5: wearing the conical straw hat on the head, big eyes peeking from under the brim, shy smile.
6: mischievous wink with one eye closed, tongue out a little, headband tails flying.
All six must clearly be the same character (olive-green skin, red headband) and all must look as cute as the reference cat.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text except the six small numerals, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the character.
Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as mus_faces.png in the current directory and report the path.
